SERVICE_NAME.description: Name of the service as provided by the init script.

PROJECT_NAME.description: Project name used for paths and system user/group.

UWSGI_PORT.description: Port the uWSGI server binds to.

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to the uWSGI configuration file.

SERVICE_DISPLAY_NAME.description: Display name for service description (used in DESC variable).

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Optional: config file for dynamic binding IP/port (from pkgos_func).

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Key/parameter name for IP address in uWSGI config.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Key/parameter name for port in uWSGI config.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Key/parameter name for worker count in uWSGI config (optional).

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user to run the service as (if not root).

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group to run the service as (if not root).

CONFIG_FILE.description: Main OpenStack config file for the service.
